template: Follow the fold sequence from the first panel through to the punch: work out how many holes will appear once the paper is fully unfolded, and decide which of the unfolded patterns below shows them in the right places. State your conclusion, justify it by describing how each fold doubles the holes and where the mirror lines fall, and end with a confidence score from 0 to 1.

independent_derivation.method: separate formulas and geometry traversals; generator answer derivation is not called

deterministic_subfact_dependency_check.method: For every target sub-fact, test every 1-to-3-field subset of the other populated sub-facts. A relation is flagged when every repeated predictor tuple maps to one target and repeated tuples cover at least 80% of eligible rows. Explicit prohibited semantic identities remain validation failures.
empirical_findings: unfolded_hole_count is empirically determined by correct_pattern (100.0% repeat coverage)

unfolded_hole_count.visual_signal: fold panels, mirror lines, and the rendered punch
unfolded_hole_count.verification_basis: exhaustive PNG decode plus domain renderer/geometry recovery

correct_pattern.visual_signal: the candidate panel matching reflected punch positions
correct_pattern.verification_basis: exhaustive PNG decode plus domain renderer/geometry recovery
